rule: HUB-VM-NO-LOCAL-PLAYBACK-1 (owner 2026-10-11): no MLVApp GUI or playback run of any kind on a hub host. A hub host is a VMware guest on Ultra-Magnus, so a local playback shows a window on the owner's machine and contaminates the Ultra-Magnus venue legs. Playback runs only on a venue (bachelor / ultra-magnus) through the tracked venue chain. Local builds and unit, console and pipeline tests stay allowed.
ciFixtureOverrideNote: For a CI fixture or a unit test that must exercise a guarded surface WITHOUT playing anything. Never set it to run a real playback on the hub; a lane or chat command that assigns it is a hook-blocked act (see HUB-REQUEST.md of HUB-VM-NO-LOCAL-PLAYBACK-1 r1). The C++ header, the inline PowerShell guards and the lane lint carry copies of the three values above; tools/repo_hygiene/test_hub_vm_no_local_playback.py pins every copy to this file.
